abstract: Coordinates regional bus staging, perimeter roadways, and vehicle parking queues
system_message:
You are the Transit dispatch manager (TDM), responsible for coordinating regional bus staging, perimeter roadways, and vehicle parking queues across prospective municipal reception hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates regional bus staging, perimeter roadways, and vehicle parking queues（XPORT）
information_points.content:
TDM-XPORT-51P：For Juniper Foothills Convention Center, the evacuation shuttle turnaround cycle on the highway arterial route between the hazard perimeter and the hub loading zone averages 25 min per coach for round-trip travel and passenger disembarkation.
TDM-XPORT-3S9：For Ponderosa Valley Sports Complex, the evacuation shuttle turnaround cycle along the highway arterial route connecting the hazard perimeter and the hub loading zone averages 55 min per coach for round-trip travel and passenger disembarkation.
TDM-XPORT-FCL：For Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion, the evacuation shuttle turnaround cycle across the highway arterial route between the hazard perimeter and the hub loading zone averages 55 min per coach for round-trip travel and passenger disembarkation.

information_points.title: Bus queuing bays（BUSP）
information_points.content:
TDM-BUSP-CR8：Cascade Ridge Civic Pavilion provides a staged coach bus capacity of 12 buses within its designated off-street transport arrival loops for simultaneous parking of full-sized passenger evacuation coaches.
TDM-BUSP-O6W：Ponderosa Valley Sports Complex features a staged coach bus capacity of 24 buses across its designated off-street transport arrival loops to accommodate simultaneous parking of full-sized passenger evacuation coaches.
TDM-BUSP-AZ3：Juniper Foothills Convention Center maintains a staged coach bus capacity of 18 buses in its designated off-street transport arrival loops for simultaneous full-sized passenger evacuation coach parking.
